info.title: Dispatch agent API
info.description: Read a DSP's drivers, routes, timecards, meal breaks, DVIC and scorecard, as far as the key may read them there. Every answer names the DSP, the days and the driver it understood, and which days each source has. An answer read from a feature the DSP has switched off, by a key that bypasses features, names it under `bypassed`. Times are the DSP's own.

key.description: An agent key made on the Agents page, or an OAuth access token issued by Sign in with Dispatch.

get.description: Use when you need the DSPs this key reaches, each DSP's date today or what the key may do and read there. Questions about days need no call to this first: every answer says which days it read.

400.description: Something unclear; message says what and choices what it could mean.

401.description: No key, or a key that is revoked, expired or not for this Dispatch.

403.description: Not for this key here: not_allowed when the key may not read it at the DSP, source_off when the DSP has the feature switched off.

404.description: Nothing by that name, or data not collected or posted yet.

422.description: The query needs too much database work; narrow the days or filters.

429.description: Too many calls this minute; wait for Retry-After seconds.

503.description: Dispatch is temporarily busy or unavailable.

get.description: Use for questions about packages: how many a driver delivered, who returned packages and why, how many were business closed. Answers a count, optionally grouped, from Amazon's record of every drop-off. Add list only when the user wants the packages themselves.

parameters.name: dsp
parameters.description: The DSP, by name. Leave it out when the key reaches one DSP.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The days as the user said them, read in the DSP's own time: yesterday, last night, last week, this month, last 14 days, 2026-09-28, 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 or 2026-W39. Weeks run Sunday to Saturday. Leave out for the last 30 days.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: One day: today, yesterday, last night or 2026-09-28.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, as 2026-09-01, with `to`; instead of `period`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, as 2026-09-30, with `from`.

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: A driver as the user named them: a name or part of one, a Driver Match code, a Paycom employee code or an Amazon transporter ID.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: delivered, returned (brought back to the station), attempted, not_picked_up (missing at the station), cancelled or open (still out when collected).

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Amazon's reason, as business_closed, object_missing, damaged, inaccessible_delivery_location, address_not_found or locker_issue; for delivered packages, where they were left, as doorstep.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: A route code, as CX101.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Count per driver, day, outcome, reason, route or address; two may be joined, as driver,reason.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Also list the packages, a page at a time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most rows to return, 1 to 500.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor an earlier answer gave, for its next page.

parameters.name: groups_cursor
parameters.description: The groups table's next_cursor; cursor separately pages the detail list.

get.summary: Contact compliance and returns to station (RTS)
get.description: Use for contact compliance: which drivers didn't do it, that is returned packages without the required call or text (contact missed, group_by driver). Also Amazon's returns to station from the weekly scorecard, their reasons, and which returns hurt the completion rate (DCR). Amazon posts a week's scorecard after it ends: for packages returned last night or this week, use packages.

parameters.name: dsp
parameters.description: The DSP, by name. Leave it out when the key reaches one DSP.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The days as the user said them, read in the DSP's own time: yesterday, last night, last week, this month, last 14 days, 2026-09-28, 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 or 2026-W39. Weeks run Sunday to Saturday. Leave out for the last 30 days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, as 2026-09-30, with `from`.

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: A driver as the user named them: a name or part of one, a Driver Match code, a Paycom employee code or an Amazon transporter ID.

parameters.name: contact
parameters.description: missed: the driver did not call or text as required; compliant: the return was excused because they did.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Amazon's RTS reason, as business_closed or object_missing.

parameters.name: impacting
parameters.description: Only returns that hurt the completion rate (DCR).

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Count per driver, reason, coaching, week or day; two may be joined.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Also list the returns, a page at a time.
